thread:
viv (sec): Heads-up: we're enforcing hardware FIDO2 (passkeys / security keys) for anyone with privileged production access (admins, oncall, deploy roles). Policy effective date: 2026-06-01.

kai (sre): TL;DR: users in groups 'prod-admins', 'deployers', and 'oncall-sre' must enroll a FIDO2 device or lose MFA exceptions.

hugo (eng): What counts as a privileged role? Does read-only dashboards count?

viv (sec): Privileged roles are scoped to write/deploy/secret access. Read-only dashboards are NOT included. If you're unsure, check the group membership tool: https://internal.redwood/tools/group-check.

renee (people-ops): Logistics: company will reimburse up to $50 for a hardware key. File expense with code SEC-FIDO. Remote folks can request a key from the office manager.

admin-bot: Automated notice: Conditional Access policy 'FIDO2_PRIV_ACCESS' created. Enforcement scheduled: 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z.

viv (sec): Migration steps: 1) Check if you're in a privileged group; 2) enroll a passkey at https://auth.redwood/enroll -> Security Keys; 3) test SSO login from a different device to ensure fallback works; 4) file a temporary exemption if you cannot enroll (valid 14 days).

kai (sre): SRE note: oncall rotation members, please enroll BEFORE your shift. We'll run a membership sweep and ping non-enrolled members starting 2026-05-20.

hugo (eng): What about service accounts / robot users?

viv (sec): Service accounts should use short-lived workload tokens (OIDC) or machine-to-machine client credentials. We will deprecate service-account passwords by 2026-07-01. If you have legacy robot users, open a ticket with sec-team for migration help.

renee (people-ops): We'll run two drop-in sessions next week for enrolling keys and answering accessibility questions. Link will be in the People Ops calendar.

viv (sec): Exceptions: emergency on-call seats can request a temporary SMS fallback for up to 48 hours, but this requires manager approval and logging. Abuse of exemptions will be revoked.

admin-bot: Reminder scheduled: enrollment-sweep starts 2026-05-20T09:00:00Z. Use `/security enroll report --team <team>` to confirm.

kai (sre): If anyone hits SSO issues after enrolling, ping #eng-oncall with the tag @kai and we'll triage.

viv (sec): Thanks. This improves our compliance posture and reduces account takeover risk. Please enroll early and let us know accessibility or hardware reimbursement issues. :key:
